format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| include: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
```

```{r}
storms |>
  filter(status %in% c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane")) |>
  distinct(year, name, status) |>
  count(year, status) |>
  mutate(status = factor(status, levels = c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, fill = status)) +
  geom_area() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("tropical depression" = "#a8d8ea",
                                "tropical storm" = "#f4a261",
                                "hurricane" = "#8b0000")) +
  labs(title = "Storm Types per Year",
       x = "Year", y = "Count", fill = "Storm Type") +
  theme_minimal()
```
